notes:
PS2 fixes for the new engine.

Fast-forward no longer freezes the picture, and it now starts from the pause menu: press Home while fast-forwarding to stop it and go straight back to the game.
The pause menu no longer gets stuck backwards after a save state is refused, and a refused save now says so instead of claiming it saved.
Both PS2 engines now share one set of memory cards, so switching engine keeps your in-game saves. Save states are still per engine.
